text.text_excerpt: Raising Cane's is located at the Riverwalk, which is a decent outlet mall. I spent many hours at this mall, avoiding the humidity as often as possible. This place is popular at the food court. I decided to give it a try. I ordered the box combo. It consists of four chicken fingers, coleslaw, fries, a slice of garlic toast, and Cane's dipping sauce. The chicken fingers were amazing! They were tender and delicious. The coleslaw was creamy and yummy. I liked the crinkle-cut fries, which is saying a ton from someone who swaps out fries for another side. I love garlic toast that is on Texas toast with sesame seeds. Yum all around! I don't know what's in the Cane special dipping sauce. I don't ...

You have to come to raising cane's when visiting New Orleans. We went with the most popular item, the Box. It comes with a drink, for chicken tenders, fries, Texas toast, and coleslaw. Also in the Box is a side of canes sauce. Trust me you don't need any other dip for your chicken. Everything seemed like it was freshly cooked to order and everything taste great. The only great was the chicken tenders were kind of small. The employees were nice and there were free refills on the drinks. Definitely worth a visit.

Was in mood for some fried chicken while at Riverwalk so decided to try Canes. Hot fresh pieces, good size and flavor, not a lot of breading and crispy. The crinkle cut fries were also good. The food court area is clean and orderly like the rest of Riverwalk.
